description: Source code for platform capabilities management in WPEFramework plugin, including classes PlatformCaps, PlatformCaps::AccountInfo, and PlatformCaps::DeviceInfo with methods for loading device and account information.

classes.name: PlatformCaps
classes.description: Main class managing platform capabilities, with nested classes for account and device info.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::AccountInfo
classes.description: Holds account-related information loaded from PlatformCapsData.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::DeviceInfo
classes.description: Holds device-related information loaded from PlatformCapsData.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads platform capabilities based on a query string, handling AccountInfo and DeviceInfo.

methods.name: AccountInfo::Load
methods.description: Loads account information such as accountId, device MAC address, experience, etc.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::Load
methods.description: Loads device information such as quirks, mime types, features, model, device type, browser info, HDR capability, etc.
